settings.lead: Tell us your dates, your airport and what you love. We plan the whole trip, seal the destination in an envelope, and you open it at the airport.

settings.headline: Four steps to
settings.subtitle: You do the fun part: packing and opening the envelope. We do the rest.

steps.title: Tell us what you love
steps.text: Pick a trip, your dates and your home airport. Tell us what you love and anywhere you'd rather not go. Five minutes, tops.

steps.title: We plan everything
steps.text: We pick the place and book flights, hotels and a few things worth doing. You get a fixed quote by email before anything is booked.

steps.title: Pack from the clues
steps.text: A week before, a clue card and a packing list arrive, with the weather. That's all you get.

steps.title: Open it at the airport
steps.text: Your sealed envelope holds the destination, your boarding passes and a pocket guide. Open it at check-in and go.

settings.headline: From a long weekend to
settings.subtitle: Every trip includes flights, hotels, booked experiences and the envelope.
settings.note: Guide prices per person. We quote every trip by email, and nothing is paid on this website.

settings.headline: Real clues from
settings.subtitle: Every traveller gets a clue card a week before they go. Can you guess where these led? Tap a card to flip it.

settings.headline: The best present is a mystery
settings.subtitle: Give someone a sealed envelope and a clue. They pick the dates; we plan the rest.
